verdict.rationale: Better Stack publishes a per-endpoint Uptime API reference with copyable curl request examples, filter variants, and paginated JSON responses, plus documented CRUD endpoints and bearer-token auth. Nothing shows an interactive in-browser console or 'try it' runner, so the examples are copy-and-run rather than runnable in place, and the OpenAPI probe found no public spec. Missing for 10: interactive in-browser request execution, a published OpenAPI/Swagger spec, independent or hands-on corroboration.
